title: Python SCHC failure streak resets before decompressed IPv6 is validated
description: Final ACK correctness review: python/src/lichen/node.py:480 calls RuleVersionFailureTracker.record_success immediately after decompress_packet, before IPv6Packet.from_bytes at 481-487. SCHC data that decompresses into structurally invalid IPv6 therefore clears a consecutive failure run and is then delivered raw, allowing notification evasion. Define success only after complete SCHC and IPv6 structural validation required by ingress, count invalid decompressed packets as failures, and drop them. Test interleaved malformed-compressed and invalid-IPv6 packets around the exact notification threshold.
